summary: Minimal sync config: under catalog.providers.rhaap with the env include key, set orgs: Default and both orgsUsersTeams and jobTemplates (enabled: true) schedules to frequency { minutes: 60 } and timeout { minutes: 15 }.
questions: What is the default portal sync frequency?
Example Helm values to sync the Default organization

answer_card.title: Minimal portal sync configuration
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
catalog:
  providers:
    rhaap:
      '{{- include "catalog.providers.env" . }}':
        orgs: Default
        sync:
          orgsUsersTeams:
            schedule:
              frequency: { minutes: 60 }
              timeout: { minutes: 15 }
          jobTemplates:
            enabled: true
            schedule:
              frequency: { minutes: 60 }
              timeout: { minutes: 15 }
```
